lesson.concept: Why a cyclone's rain reaches far beyond landfall
lesson.big_idea: A cyclone is not a dot on a map. Its rainbands spread hundreds of kilometres, and the slower it moves, the longer they pour on the same places.

steps.title: A spinning storm around an eye
steps.text: A cyclone is a huge spinning system of cloud around a calm centre called the eye. The strongest winds blow in a ring just around the eye, so wind damage is worst near landfall.

steps.title: Rain spreads in long bands
steps.text: Rain falls in spiral strips called rainbands that curl out from the centre. IMD says Akvan's outer rainbands may reach 500 km from its centre, far wider than its worst winds.

steps.title: Speed sets the hours of rain
steps.text: Total rain at a place is rain per hour times hours of rain. A slow storm keeps its bands overhead longer. IMD flags 21 cm or more as extremely heavy. On 17 November Akvan was moving at about 6 kmph.

steps.title: Over land, wind fades, rain lingers
steps.text: Over land a cyclone loses the warm sea water that feeds it, so its winds weaken. Its moisture still moves inland as rain, which is why inland Odisha districts like Sundargarh have alerts for 21–22 November.

example.setup: Imagine a coastal town right on a cyclone's path. Assume heavy bands soak it while the centre is within 200 km, at 0.6 cm of rain an hour. Compare a storm moving at 20 kmph with one at 10 kmph.

lines.label: Distance to pass
lines.note: The centre must cover this before the rain stops (assumed).

lines.label: Fast storm's hours
lines.note: Assume the fast storm moves at 20 kmph.

lines.label: Fast storm's rain
lines.note: Assumed rate of 0.6 cm an hour.

lines.label: Slow storm's hours
lines.note: Half the speed means double the time overhead.

lines.label: Slow storm's rain
lines.note: Above 21 cm, the level IMD calls extremely heavy.

example.result: Same storm, same rain per hour. Halving the speed doubled the hours and the rain, from 12 cm to 24 cm, pushing the town past the extremely heavy mark.

apply.text: On 17 November Akvan was moving at only about 6 kmph, and its rainbands may reach 500 km from the centre. So IMD warns of isolated rain of 21 cm or more in north coastal Andhra, and Odisha, north of the Nellore–Tuni landfall zone, has orange alerts and 2.04 lakh people listed for possible evacuation.

practice.q: Same town, same 0.6 cm an hour and same 400 km to pass, but the storm crawls at 8 kmph. How much rain falls?
practice.answer: Hours: 400 km ÷ 8 kmph = 50 hours. Rain: 50 × 0.6 cm = 30 cm. That is above 21 cm, so it is in the extremely heavy range, and more than double the fast storm's 12 cm.

stories.headline: US loses measles-free status after 26 years, with Mexico and Bolivia
stories.question: How did the US lose its measles-free status after 26 years?
stories.dek: PAHO ruled on 17 November 2026 that one measles strain had spread unbroken in the US for 12 months or more. US child vaccination is below PAHO's 95% target; so is India's.

so_far.text: Measles once infected nearly every American child by age 15. A vaccine arrived in 1963, and in 2000 the US was declared measles-eliminated. That means the virus no longer spreads continuously inside the country. It does not mean zero cases. US outbreaks were reported from 20 January 2025, and Mexico's from 1 February 2025. In November 2025 Canada lost its elimination status, so the Americas lost their regional measles-free status.

what_happened.text: On 17 November 2026 the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), the World Health Organization's office for the Americas, said endemic measles transmission had been re-established in Bolivia, Mexico and the United States. All three lost their elimination status, ending 26 years of US measles-free status. Transmission counts as re-established when the same virus genotype and lineage circulate unbroken for 12 months or more. The CDC counted 5,412 US cases in 2026 up to 12 November.

steps.text: US kindergarten MMR coverage slid from 95.2% in 2019–20 to 92.4% in 2025–26, below PAHO's 95% target.
PAHO warns that national averages can hide pockets of low coverage, where many people may lack protection.
Travellers keep importing measles; where coverage gaps exist, a case can start a chain rather than die out.
One US chain of the same genotype and lineage ran unbroken 12 months or more; where it spread is not reported.
Under PAHO's rule that counts as endemic spread again, so the US lost its elimination status.

history.text:
Before the first measles vaccine in 1963, nearly all American children caught measles by 15. The US saw up to four million cases a year. Vaccination broke that cycle, and in 2000 the US was declared measles-eliminated. Travellers still brought the virus in, but each chain of infection died out.

Elimination depends on high vaccine coverage. In 2019–20, 95.2% of US kindergarten children had the MMR vaccine, which protects against measles, mumps and rubella. By 2025–26 coverage had slipped to 92.4%, below the 95% PAHO says every community needs. In 2024 the US had only 285 cases.

From 20 January 2025, US outbreaks began; Mexico's followed from 1 February 2025. The US ended 2025 with 2,289 cases and three deaths, the most since 1991 and 19 times the 2024 figure. In November 2025 Canada lost its status, so the Americas as a whole lost their verified measles-free status. US spread continued into 2026. On 17 November 2026 PAHO ruled that the US, Mexico and Bolivia had lost their status too.

analogy.text: Think of the country as a field and imported cases as sparks blowing in. Elimination means every spark is put out before it spreads. Status is lost when one fire, from the same spark, keeps burning for a full year. Unvaccinated pockets are dry grass that can keep it alive.

for_you.text: No direct effect on life in India, and we found no new travel advice. But India's measles-rubella coverage in 2024–25 was 93.7% (first dose) and 92.2% (second), both below 95%. India's elimination target, pushed back since 2015, is now 2026. Dr T. Jacob John of India's expert advisory group called it realistic in April 2025 but wanted state and district plans.

misconception.myth: Measles-free means a country has zero measles cases.
misconception.fact: Elimination means the virus no longer spreads continuously. Imported cases and short outbreaks can happen; status is lost only when one lineage spreads unbroken for 12 months.

next.text: To regain status, the US, Mexico and Bolivia must stop endemic spread for at least 12 months, document it, and strengthen vaccination, surveillance and outbreak response. Reversing the US foothold will take years, TIME reported.

lesson.concept: How a country loses measles elimination status
lesson.big_idea: A country stays measles-eliminated as long as every imported chain of infection dies out. It loses that status when one chain of the same virus keeps spreading, unbroken, for 12 months.

steps.title: Elimination is not zero cases
steps.text: Elimination means the virus no longer spreads continuously inside a country. Cases can still appear, because travellers bring measles in from abroad. In 2026, 18 US cases were among international visitors.

steps.title: Every chain has a fingerprint
steps.text: Labs read each sample's genotype and lineage, the virus's genetic family and branch. Cases with the same lineage, spreading one after another, are treated as one continuous chain.

steps.title: The 12-month clock
steps.text: If the same genotype and lineage circulates without a break for 12 months or more, PAHO counts transmission as re-established, or endemic. The country then loses its elimination status.

steps.title: Vaccine gaps can keep chains alive
steps.text: Measles needs unprotected people to keep moving. PAHO wants at least 95% two-dose coverage in every community. Two doses cut infection risk by 97%. Pockets below that can let a chain run for months.

steps.title: Winning it back
steps.text: To regain status, a country must stop endemic spread for at least 12 months, document it, and strengthen vaccination, surveillance and outbreak response.

example.setup: Imagine a measles-free country called Testland. In January a traveller arrives with measles of lineage A, and the virus reaches a town where many children are unvaccinated.

lines.label: January: the spark
lines.note: An imported case alone does not cost the status.

lines.label: March: local spread
lines.note: Many unprotected children, so the chain keeps going.

lines.label: July: new outbreak
lines.calc: Lineage A again, in another region
lines.note: Same genetic branch, so labs link it to January's chain.

lines.label: Next January
lines.calc: Lineage A still spreading, no break: 12 months
lines.note: The 12-month line is crossed.

lines.label: Verdict
lines.note: The unbroken chain decides it, not the case total.

example.result: Testland lost its status not because of one big number, but because one chain of lineage A was never stopped for a full year. Closing the low-coverage pocket early could have broken it.

apply.text: This is what happened in the US. Outbreaks were reported from 20 January 2025. On 17 November 2026, after its commission reviewed national reports, PAHO ruled that endemic transmission was re-established. To regain status, the US must now stop that spread for at least 12 months and document it.

practice.q: Suppose Testland's lineage A spreads from March to November, then vanishes. In January a new lineage B arrives and spreads until June. Has Testland lost its status?
practice.answer: Check each chain separately. Lineage A ran March to November: nine months, then stopped. Lineage B is a different branch, so its clock starts fresh: January to June is six months. Neither reached 12 unbroken months, so Testland keeps its status.

terms.meaning: A disease that keeps spreading inside a country on its own, not just from imports.
The virus's genetic family and branch, used to tell whether cases are linked.
Two-dose shot that protects against measles, mumps and rubella.
The virus no longer spreads continuously within a country; some cases can still occur.

check.q: A country has 300 measles cases in a year, all from separate imported strains that die out within weeks. Does it lose elimination status?
options: Yes, 300 cases is too many
No, no single lineage spread unbroken for 12 months
Yes, any outbreak ends elimination status
check.why: Status depends on one genotype and lineage circulating uninterrupted for 12 months or more, not on the total number of cases.

takeaways: A country loses measles-free status when one virus lineage spreads unbroken for 12 months.
On 17 November 2026 the US lost its 26-year status; its child vaccination is below 95%.
Watch whether countries stop spread for 12 months, and whether India meets its 2026 target.

November 2025 mein Canada ne apna status khoya, isliye poore Americas region ka measles-free status chala gaya.

scenes.speak: पहली vaccine 1963 में आई, और उसने यह cycle तोड़ दिया। 2000 में America को measles-eliminated declare किया गया। Travellers फिर भी cases लाते रहे, लेकिन हर chain ख़त्म हो जाती थी। फिर 20 January 2025 से America में outbreaks शुरू हुए। Mexico में 1 February से। November 2025 में Canada ने अपना status खोया, इसलिए पूरे Americas region का measles-free status चला गया।

scenes.say: America ke case counts dekhiye. 2024 mein sirf 285. 2025 mein 2289, aur 3 deaths. Yeh 1991 ke baad sabse zyada tha, aur pichhle saal se 19 guna. Aur 2026 mein yeh number pehle hi double se zyada ho chuka hai.
scenes.show: US cases: 285 to 5,412 in two years
scenes.speak: America के case counts देखिए। 2024 में सिर्फ़ 285। 2025 में 2289, और 3 deaths। यह 1991 के बाद सबसे ज़्यादा था, और पिछले साल से 19 गुना। और 2026 में यह number पहले ही double से ज़्यादा हो चुका है।

scenes.say: Toh yeh hua kaise? Pehle vaccines dekhte hain. 2019 se 2020 mein America ke pachaanve point do percent kindergarten bachchon ko MMR vaccine lagi thi, jo measles, mumps aur rubella se bachati hai. 2025 se 2026 tak yeh girkar baanve point chaar percent ho gaya. PAHO ka target kam se kam 95 hai.
scenes.speak: तो यह हुआ कैसे? पहले vaccines देखते हैं। 2019 से 2020 में America के पचानवे point दो percent kindergarten बच्चों को MMR vaccine लगी थी, जो measles, mumps और rubella से बचाती है। 2025 से 2026 तक यह गिरकर बानवे point चार percent हो गया। PAHO का target कम से कम 95 है।

scenes.say: PAHO warn karta hai ki national average low coverage wale pockets ko chhupa sakta hai. Travellers measles laate rehte hain. Jahan aise gaps hon, wahan ek imported case khatam hone ki jagah chain shuru kar sakta hai. America mein same lineage ki ek chain 12 mahine ya usse zyada chali. Reports yeh nahi batati ki woh kahan faili. PAHO ke rule ke hisaab se measles phir se endemic hai.
scenes.show: Coverage gaps can keep chains alive
scenes.speak: PAHO warn करता है कि national average low coverage वाले pockets को छुपा सकता है। Travellers measles लाते रहते हैं। जहाँ ऐसे gaps हों, वहाँ एक imported case ख़त्म होने की जगह chain शुरू कर सकता है। America में same lineage की एक chain 12 महीने या उससे ज़्यादा चली। Reports यह नहीं बताती कि वो कहाँ फैली। PAHO के rule के हिसाब से measles फिर से endemic है।

scenes.say: Ab faisla kisne kiya? PAHO ki expert body, Regional Monitoring and Re-Verification Commission, ne har desh ki reports review ki. PAHO ke Director, Doctor Jarbas Barbosa, ne uske findings accept kiye. Aur America mein cases Centers for Disease Control ginta hai.
scenes.speak: अब फ़ैसला किसने किया? PAHO की expert body, Regional Monitoring and Re-Verification Commission, ने हर देश की reports review कीं। PAHO के Director, Doctor Jarbas Barbosa, ने उसके findings accept किए। और America में cases Centers for Disease Control गिनता है।

scenes.speak: अब पूरे region को देखिए। 13 November 2026 तक Americas में 58213 confirmed cases और 82 deaths थे। पिछले साल इसी period में 12806 cases थे। यानी लगभग साढ़े चार गुना।

scenes.say: Ab woh ek idea jo yaad rakhna hai: koi desh measles elimination status kaise khota hai. Step one. Elimination ka matlab zero cases nahi hai. Iska matlab hai ki virus desh ke andar lagataar nahi fail raha. Travellers phir bhi use laate hain. 2026 mein America ke 18 cases international visitors the.
scenes.speak: अब वो एक idea जो याद रखना है: कोई देश measles elimination status कैसे खोता है। Step one। Elimination का मतलब zero cases नहीं है। इसका मतलब है कि virus देश के अंदर लगातार नहीं फैल रहा। Travellers फिर भी उसे लाते हैं। 2026 में America के 18 cases international visitors थे।

scenes.say: Step two. Har chain ka ek fingerprint hota hai. Labs virus ka genotype aur lineage, yaani uski genetic family aur branch, padhkar cases ko link karti hain. Step three. 12 mahine ki ghadi. Agar ek lineage 12 mahine ya usse zyada bina ruke faile, toh desh apna status kho deta hai.
scenes.speak: Step two। हर chain का एक fingerprint होता है। Labs virus का genotype और lineage, यानी उसकी genetic family और branch, पढ़कर cases को link करती हैं। Step three। 12 महीने की घड़ी। अगर एक lineage 12 महीने या उससे ज़्यादा बिना रुके फैले, तो देश अपना status खो देता है।

scenes.say: Step four. Vaccine gaps chains ko zinda rakh sakte hain. 2 doses infection ka risk 97 percent kam karte hain, aur PAHO chahta hai ki har community mein 95 percent two-dose coverage ho. Step five. Status wapas paane ke liye desh ko 12 mahine tak spread rokna hoga, use document karna hoga, aur vaccination, surveillance aur outbreak response mazboot karna hoga.
scenes.speak: Step four। Vaccine gaps chains को ज़िंदा रख सकते हैं। 2 doses infection का risk 97 percent कम करते हैं, और PAHO चाहता है कि हर community में 95 percent two-dose coverage हो। Step five। Status वापस पाने के लिए देश को 12 महीने तक spread रोकना होगा, उसे document करना होगा, और vaccination, surveillance और outbreak response मज़बूत करना होगा।

scenes.say: Ek example lete hain. Maan lijiye Testland naam ka ek measles-free desh hai. January mein ek traveller lineage A wala measles lekar aata hai. March tak yeh ek town mein fail jaata hai, jahan maan lete hain sirf 80 percent bachchon ko 2 doses lage hain. July mein lineage A ek doosre region mein milta hai. Labs use January wale case se link karti hain.
scenes.speak: एक example लेते हैं। मान लीजिए Testland नाम का एक measles-free देश है। January में एक traveller lineage A वाला measles लेकर आता है। March तक यह एक town में फैल जाता है, जहाँ मान लेते हैं सिर्फ़ 80 percent बच्चों को 2 doses लगे हैं। July में lineage A एक दूसरे region में मिलता है। Labs उसे January वाले case से link करती हैं।

scenes.say: Agle January, lineage A ab bhi fail raha hai, bina ruke. Yeh 12 mahine hue, isliye Testland apna status kho deta hai. Faisla total cases se nahi hua, balki is baat se ki ek chain kabhi ruki nahi. Quick test: agar lineage A 9 mahine baad ruk jaata, aur ek naya lineage B 6 mahine failta, toh Testland ka status bana rehta.
scenes.speak: अगले January, lineage A अब भी फैल रहा है, बिना रुके। यह 12 महीने हुए, इसलिए Testland अपना status खो देता है। फ़ैसला total cases से नहीं हुआ, बल्कि इस बात से कि एक chain कभी रुकी नहीं। Quick test: अगर lineage A 9 महीने बाद रुक जाता, और एक नया lineage B 6 महीने फैलता, तो Testland का status बना रहता।

scenes.say: Ek common galti dekhiye. Bahut log sochte hain ki measles-free ka matlab zero cases hai. Aisa nahi hai. Imported cases aur chhote outbreaks ho sakte hain, aur status nahi jaata. Asal baat yeh hai ki kya ek chain poore ek saal tak failti rehti hai.
scenes.speak: एक common ग़लती देखिए। बहुत लोग सोचते हैं कि measles-free का मतलब zero cases है। ऐसा नहीं है। Imported cases और छोटे outbreaks हो सकते हैं, और status नहीं जाता। असल बात यह है कि क्या एक chain पूरे एक साल तक फैलती रहती है।

scenes.say: Ab India. Yahan zindagi par koi seedha asar nahi hai, aur humein koi nayi travel advice nahi mili. Lekin 2024 se 2025 mein India ka measles-rubella vaccine coverage pehli dose ke liye tiraanve point saat percent tha, aur doosri ke liye baanve point do. Dono 95 se neeche hain.
scenes.speak: अब India। यहाँ ज़िंदगी पर कोई सीधा असर नहीं है, और हमें कोई नई travel advice नहीं मिली। लेकिन 2024 से 2025 में India का measles-rubella vaccine coverage पहली dose के लिए तिरानवे point सात percent था, और दूसरी के लिए बानवे point दो। दोनों 95 से नीचे हैं।

scenes.say: India ka elimination target 2015 se kai baar aage badhaya gaya hai, aur ab yeh 2026 hai. April 2025 mein India ke expert advisory group ke Doctor T. Jacob John ne ise realistic kaha, lekin state aur district plans ki maang ki. PAHO ki warning yahan bhi laagu hoti hai: national average low coverage wale pockets ko chhupa sakta hai.
scenes.image: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
scenes.speak: India का elimination target 2015 से कई बार आगे बढ़ाया गया है, और अब यह 2026 है। April 2025 में India के expert advisory group के Doctor T. Jacob John ने इसे realistic कहा, लेकिन state और district plans की माँग की। PAHO की warning यहाँ भी लागू होती है: national average low coverage वाले pockets को छुपा सकता है।

scenes.say: Aage kya hoga? Status wapas paane ke liye America, Mexico aur Bolivia ko kam se kam 12 mahine tak spread rokna hoga, use document karna hoga, aur vaccination, surveillance aur outbreak response mazboot karna hoga. TIME ne report kiya ki America mein measles ki is pakad ko palatne mein saalon lagenge.
scenes.speak: आगे क्या होगा? Status वापस पाने के लिए America, Mexico और Bolivia को कम से कम 12 महीने तक spread रोकना होगा, उसे document करना होगा, और vaccination, surveillance और outbreak response मज़बूत करना होगा। TIME ने report किया कि America में measles की इस पकड़ को पलटने में सालों लगेंगे।

scenes.say: Abhi tak pata nahi: faisle ke waqt Mexico aur Bolivia ke official case counts, America ki chain theek kab shuru hui, kya nayi traveller advice aayegi, aur kya India apna 2026 ka target poora karega.
scenes.speak: अभी तक पता नहीं: फ़ैसले के वक़्त Mexico और Bolivia के official case counts, America की chain ठीक कब शुरू हुई, क्या नई traveller advice आएगी, और क्या India अपना 2026 का target पूरा करेगा।

scenes.say: Teen baatein yaad rakhiye. Ek: koi desh measles-free status tab khota hai jab ek lineage 12 mahine bina ruke failta hai. Do: 17 November 2026 ko America ne apna 26 saal purana status khoya, aur wahan bachchon ka vaccination 95 percent se neeche hai. Teen: dekhiye ki kya yeh desh 12 mahine tak spread rok paate hain, aur kya India apna 2026 ka target poora karta hai.
scenes.speak: तीन बातें याद रखिए। एक: कोई देश measles-free status तब खोता है जब एक lineage 12 महीने बिना रुके फैलता है। दो: 17 November 2026 को America ने अपना 26 साल पुराना status खोया, और वहाँ बच्चों का vaccination 95 percent से नीचे है। तीन: देखिए कि क्या ये देश 12 महीने तक spread रोक पाते हैं, और क्या India अपना 2026 का target पूरा करता है।

APEC rules forbid leaders from discussing nuclear weapons
